title: W1 Judge Packet v1 (lane-agnostic)
description: Immutable blinded evaluation packet shared by all judges. Contains no evaluator lane, family, model, or source/version cues. Candidate keys must be opaque labels only (A, B, C1, C2, C3). Judgments are in separate result files — not inside this packet.

packet_id.description: Opaque packet identifier. Pattern: {skill}-{evaluator_type}-{index}. No lane in the packet ID.

evaluator_type.description: paired_lift: A vs B single upgraded seed. diversity: C1/C2/C3 upgraded seeds. anti_slop: C1/C2/C3 checked for slop patterns.

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 of the user_prompt from the job packet. Allows verifiers to confirm the scenario prompt has not drifted.

calibration_ref.description: Repo-relative path to calibration file. All judges must review calibration before grading.

candidates.description: Blinded output candidates. Keys must be opaque labels only: A, B (paired_lift) or C1, C2, C3 (diversity/anti_slop). No run_type, job_id, skill_version, executor, or source cues in keys or values.

label.description: Opaque label matching the parent key.

raw_output_hash.description: SHA-256 of raw_output for integrity verification.

raw_output.description: Full model output text. Present in private packets only. Must be absent in public index files.
